EPIC STATE SNAPSHOT + APPROVED-PLAN UPDATE (2026-06-04).

LATEST APPROVED PLAN (additions to the option-a-pivot-plan source of truth):
- ADR-0020 (two-tier hardening over merge_queue) STANDS. ADR-0016 KEEP version-bump STANDS (0f17).
- ADR-0022 (identity-based admin exemption) — NEW, supersedes ADR-0021 + the HMAC admin-exemption ledger (story 2730). Per maintainer direction (bypass-actor = a designated human admin merging via the GitHub UI; no persistent PAT), an admin FP-recovery override now propagates by IDENTITY: a SHA whose covering merged PR's server-set merged_by.id is in ruleset.bypass_user_ids is reviewed-equivalent in BOTH Goal-1 gates. Forge-proof by construction (agent is current_user_can_bypass:never). No signing key, no ledger, no second override. Converged via 3-lens panel + convergence review.

CURRENT STATE:
- LANDED on main: a85d (fail-closed silent-pass gates, exit-78 x3), the two-tier flow + provenance-skip + FP-recovery, 2730 (admin-exemption ledger — now SUPERSEDED/retired by ADR-0022), 29e7 (sg dangling matcher, PR #631), and override-propagation (DD4, now identity-based: bypass-actor-set.sh + merged_by-in-set wiring in review-coverage-lib.sh + verify-session-provenance G3; HMAC ledger/scripts deleted).
- IN FLIGHT: the identity-exemption re-promotion (story/588e-abec-221f-42c0/3ebb-idexempt-fix2, f37271442e) — landing to main now (a no-relative-paths CI fix re-promoted after PR #640 wedged Script Tests).
- CLOSEABLE: 29e7 (completion-verifier P1=PASS, 4/4 DDs) — closing now.
- 3ebb: DD4/override-propagation (identity) DONE; but its FORMAL DD1 (tristate PASS/FAIL/INDETERMINATE contract doc), DD2 (durable --resume INC-008 guard), DD3 (INDETERMINATE->fp-recovery escalation) are NOT implemented (completion-verifier P1=FAIL 0/3) — story STAYS OPEN; DD4 was a comment-tracked add, not a formal DD.

REMAINING CRITICAL PATH TO ENFORCE-GO-LIVE: 7b77 (coverage-ledger CF-6 stability, READY) -> 0cd7 (THE architectural core: single fail-closed review-gate summary check + shared diff-exemption helper) -> 3783 (allowlist tightening) -> 3ee4 (enforce-flip on live main ruleset). 0f17 (version-bump KEEP) + cca8 (linear-history cutover) also gate 3ee4; 3ebb DD1-3 feed in; 830c (UX/docs/ADR-0020 update/EPIC CLOSURE) depends on 3ee4.

PIVOT FOLLOW-UPS (fold into 3ee4 prereqs, recorded in ADR-0022): (1) admin-run assertion that ruleset.bypass_user_ids subset of the LIVE ruleset bypass_actors (ruleset-design-invariants locks only the can_bypass:never OUTCOME, not actor identity); (2) merged_by.id in fp-recovery-audit-sweep markers for the deferred reconciliation backstop. Story-plan pivot updates applied to: 3ebb, 3ee4 (P8c prereq item 3), 0cd7 (FAST-FOLLOW), 2730 (superseded marker).
